newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ifo rebases west German business climate index.
newsitem.headline: Ifo rebases west German business climate index.

text.p: The IFO economic institute said on Tuesday it had rebased its business climate index to the 1991 year from the 1985 base used up until now.
In a statement, IFO said that the new base year would be used for the announcement of the January figure due on Thursday. The east German data will remain unchanged as this already used a 1991 base.

In December 1996, the business climate index on the old base stood at 95.8 for west Germany. Under the new calculation, where 1991=100, it falls to 91.0. The December data for east Germany was 104.4. --Frankfurt Newsroom +49 69 756525
